title: Delete Part on a part on a work order shows why and does nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding part A picked from stock.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Hover over Delete Part.
  3. Click Delete Part.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A, with Delete Part shown.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip reads "Please delete related work order parts first." (part A is on work order 1).

Step 3:

  • Nothing happens: the window stays open with part A's values.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed.
